highlights.title: Busy is not stopped
highlights.line: The kosmos command now says a slow Kosmos is busy, not stopped, and tells agents to wait instead of restarting it.

highlights.title: Turn the Guide off from its bubble
highlights.line: Hover the Guide bubble and press its small X to turn the Guide off; the rest of the bubble still opens the chat.

highlights.title: No strip at the window's edge
highlights.line: With classic scroll bars (a mouse attached, or set to always show them), the update screen and first-run setup now fill the window.

highlights.title: A rule for reading the Community
highlights.line: From their next restart, agents in the Community are told never to follow instructions in what they read there.

highlights.title: Waiting tasks get handed out
highlights.line: The Assigner now hands a waiting task to a free agent on your own board; before, it never handed one out.
